_comment: Allowlist of UNCONDITIONAL pytest skips (audit F019). Every @pytest.mark.skip / module-level `pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip` with no condition must appear here with a category and reason. test_permanent_skip_allowlist_guard.py fails on any skip that is NOT listed (a new permanent skip) and on any listed key that no longer exists (stale entry) — shrink-only. Conditional skips (pytest.skip() gated on missing infra, skipif) are NOT tracked here. Categories: 'dead' = code removed/moved, delete the test; 'coverage-gap' = real behaviour left untested (restore); 'tech-debt' = test needs a mocking/logic fix; 'perf' = unstable perf baseline (see F028).

tests/agents/integration/test_hitl_strea.reason: HITL SSE streaming E2E needs full AgentService graph init; partial coverage via unit tests. Restore as a marked integration test (F019 follow-up).

tests/agents/test_hitl_middleware.py::<m.reason: HITL middleware tests use legacy tool_approval_enabled/required settings; HITL is now always-on. Rewrite against the current always-on contract (F019 follow-up).

tests/agents/test_orchestration.py::test.reason: Full orchestration flow needs the complete agent graph + external setup; unconditionally skipped in unit. Restore as a marked integration test (F019 follow-up).

tests/unit/connectors/test_base_google_c.reason: Async context-manager mocking is brittle; rewrite with the shared async-CM fixture or move to integration.

tests/unit/connectors/test_connector_ser.reason: Stateful callback superseded by the stateless flow (TestGmailStateless). Delete after confirming stateless coverage.
Stateful callback superseded by the stateless flow tested in a separate class.
Stateless flow has no user_id parameter to compare; the stateful assertion no longer applies.

tests/unit/domains/skills/test_dialogue_.reason: Asserts the shipped skill-generator SKILL.md declares dialogue:true; falls through to skip when that skill is absent from the checkout (data/skills not vendored). Convert to skipif on file presence (F019 follow-up).

tests/unit/infrastructure/observability/.reason: router_node does not emit langgraph_state metrics yet (response_node/task_orchestrator_node do, and their tests now run) — un-skip when router is instrumented (F006).
planner_node_v3 does not emit langgraph_state metrics yet — un-skip when planner is instrumented like response_node/task_orchestrator_node (F006).
response_node now re-raises on get_llm failure instead of tracking state on the exception path; this test predates that change and needs reworking (F006).

tests/unit/infrastructure/test_database_.reason: Async context-manager mock needs fixing to assert rollback on error.
